digest.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
digest.tldr: OpenAI's newly announced suite of office features puts it into mor direct competition with more traditional software companies.

digest.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
digest.tldr: Dots are meant to operate independent of any specific hardware or interface, pursuing user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

digest.title: OpenAI gives Codex reusable cloud environments that work across devices
digest.tldr: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud development environments, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools and a security-focused product for scanning repositories and preparing fixes.

digest.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
digest.tldr: 1 Sol delivers significant improvements over GPT-6 Sol across complex professional tasks, including code writing and debugging, document understanding, and executing multi-step business workflows.

digest.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
digest.tldr: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plugins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.
